privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires calculating mB and Mwp magnitudes for the Noto earthquake. The input event is at /home/ga/seiscomp/var/lib/events/noto_earthquake.scml and the output must be at /home/ga/Documents/noto_reprocessed.scml. Valid magnitude results for this event (M7.5) should typically fall between 6.8 and 8.2. The agent must use the SeisComP software suite to perform these calculations.
